sec06-card-sec06-F31.question_text: Must your blood alcohol reach unlawful intoxication before your driving ability becomes impaired?
sec06-card-sec06-F31.teaching_text: Blowing under the per-se number offers zero protection if dulled judgment causes a crash or unsafe driving.

sec06-card-sec06-R02.question_text: How does the point-zero-five research benchmark compare with Alabama's point-zero-eight adult unlawful threshold?
sec06-card-sec06-R02.teaching_text: Keeping point zero five and point zero eight distinct prevents mixing up biological impairment with adult per-se illegality.

sec06-card-sec06-F42.question_text: Why do some drinkers feel energized or revved up when alcohol is actually a depressant?
sec06-card-sec06-F42.teaching_text: Losing caution and self-control tricks drinkers into feeling bold right as their steering precision falls apart.

sec06-card-sec06-F43.question_text: Does choosing beer, wine, or whiskey change impairment, or what single factor actually matters?
sec06-card-sec06-F43.teaching_text: Your brain reacts strictly to total ethanol entering your bloodstream, regardless of mixer, label, or drink style.

sec06-card-sec06-F44.question_text: Why can the exact same drink hit you harder one day than another, especially around meals?
sec06-card-sec06-F44.teaching_text: Without food slowing absorption, even a small drink spikes bloodstream alcohol much faster than after a meal.

sec06-card-sec06-F45.question_text: Why do black coffee, food, and cold showers fail to make an impaired drinker sober?
sec06-card-sec06-F45.teaching_text: Cold water or caffeine just produces a wide-awake drunk until your liver oxidizes the alcohol.

sec06-card-sec06-F46.question_text: Which seven driving abilities and mental safeguards does the manual say alcohol damages or destroys?
sec06-card-sec06-F46.teaching_text: Attacking coordination and vision while inflating overconfidence creates the worst possible combination behind a steering wheel.

sec06-card-sec06-F27.question_text: Under Alabama law, what general blood alcohol concentration or condition makes driving unlawful?
sec06-card-sec06-F27.teaching_text: Officers can arrest at eight hundredths flat or whenever alcohol noticeably impairs safe driving below that mark.

sec06-card-sec06-F32.question_text: Besides driving drunk, what does state law ban regarding drugs, mixed substances, and physical control of a car?
sec06-card-sec06-F32.teaching_text: Sitting behind the wheel in actual physical control while impaired by prescriptions or combinations violates DUI law too.

sec06-card-sec06-F33.question_text: What blood alcohol concentration makes driving unlawful for commercial vehicle operators in Alabama?
sec06-card-sec06-F33.teaching_text: Heavy rigs carry double stopping distances and massive crash energy, cutting the legal threshold exactly in half.

sec06-card-sec06-F34.question_text: At what blood alcohol concentration is driving unlawful for anyone under age twenty-one in Alabama?
sec06-card-sec06-F34.teaching_text: Alabama's youth threshold sits so low that even part of one drink puts underage drivers over the line.

sec06-card-sec06-F35.question_text: Which strict blood alcohol concentration cutoff applies to school bus and daycare vehicle drivers?
sec06-card-sec06-F35.teaching_text: Drivers entrusted with children's lives face the same ultra-strict two-hundredths ceiling as underage motorists.

sec06-card-sec06-R01.question_text: How do Alabama's unlawful alcohol cutoffs compare across general adults, commercial drivers, under-twenty-one drivers, and school-bus or daycare drivers?
sec06-card-sec06-R01.teaching_text: Grouping underage, school bus, and daycare drivers together at point zero two makes all four numbers effortless.

sec06-card-sec06-F40.question_text: Simply by driving on Alabama public highways, which three chemical tests have you already agreed to take?
sec06-card-sec06-F40.teaching_text: Using public roads carries built-in consent to alcohol testing, no separate roadside signature required.

sec06-card-sec06-F41.question_text: What happens to your driver license if you are arrested for DUI and refuse a directed chemical breath test?
sec06-card-sec06-F41.teaching_text: Refusing the breathalyzer triggers automatic license loss on its own, separate from the courtroom DUI case.

sec06-card-sec06-F36.question_text: What fine range, maximum jail time, and license suspension hit a first Alabama DUI conviction?
sec06-card-sec06-F36.teaching_text: Even a first-offense misdemeanor carries thousands in potential fines, up to a year jailed, and three pedestrian months.

sec06-card-sec06-F37.question_text: What fines, mandatory jail or community service, and license penalty follow a second DUI within ten years?
sec06-card-sec06-F37.teaching_text: Offense two inside a decade jumps from temporary suspension to full one-year revocation plus mandatory lockup or service.

sec06-card-sec06-F38.question_text: What fine range, license revocation length, and non-suspendable minimum jail time hit a third DUI conviction?
sec06-card-sec06-F38.teaching_text: Judges cannot probate or suspend those sixty mandatory jail days on a third conviction.

sec06-card-sec06-F39.question_text: How is a fourth or later DUI classified, and what fines, revocation, and prison range follow?
sec06-card-sec06-F39.teaching_text: Crossing into felony status brings multi-year state prison exposure above one year and a five-year license loss.

sec06-card-sec06-R03.question_text: How does the driver-license penalty escalate from a first DUI conviction to a second within ten years?
sec06-card-sec06-R03.teaching_text: Notice both the longer duration and the jump from suspension on offense one to full revocation on two.

sec06-card-sec06-R04.question_text: How do license loss and offense grade step up from a third DUI conviction to a fourth or later?
sec06-card-sec06-R04.teaching_text: Offense four crosses from misdemeanor territory into a Class C felony while adding two extra revoked years.
